error.title: Could not load the data

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address is incorrect or the page has been moved.
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Enter your email address. We will send a one-time sign-in link, no password needed.
login.error.emailInvalid: The email address looks incorrect. Use the format name@company.com.
login.error.send: Could not send the link. Please try again in a moment.
login.sent.title: Check your inbox
login.sent.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. The link works once and for a limited time. If the message does not arrive, check your spam folder or send the link again.
login.token.summary: I have a link or token
login.token.hint: If the link from the message does not open automatically (for example in development mode, file in runtime/outbox), paste it here.
login.token.label: Link or token
login.token.error.required: Paste the link or token from the message.
login.token.error.invalid: The link or token is invalid or has expired. Request a new link.
onboarding.title: Create an organization
onboarding.lead: Reports and keys belong to an organization. All we need is a name and acceptance of the data processing agreement.
onboarding.name: Organization name
onboarding.name.hint: For example your company name. It appears in report headers.
onboarding.dpa: I accept the data processing agreement (DPA, version 1)
onboarding.dpa.link: Read the agreement (opens in a new tab)
onboarding.error.name: Enter an organization name (at least 2 characters).
onboarding.error.dpa: To continue, accept the data processing agreement.
onboarding.error.send: Could not create the organization. Please try again.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.latest.title: Weekly report
dashboard.cta.title: New report
dashboard.cta.body: Upload a CSV, XLSX or a JSON package from the collector. The report will be ready in a few moments.
dashboard.archive.title: Report archive
dashboard.archive.caption: Reports, newest first
dashboard.empty.title: You do not have a report yet
dashboard.empty.body: Upload a CSV file exported from your sales system (required columns: date, revenue, cost and category) and we will prepare a week-over-week report. Not sure what the file should look like? Download the template with sample data.
dashboard.error.title: Could not load the reports
upload.title: Upload file
upload.lead: Choose a file, review the detected columns and run the report.
upload.steps.label: File upload steps
upload.dropzone.title: Drag a file here
upload.dropzone.hint: Accepted formats: CSV, XLSX or a JSON package from the collector. Up to {limit} (JSON package: {packageLimit}).
upload.error.type: The file must be CSV, XLSX or JSON (a collector package). Save the spreadsheet as CSV and upload it again.
upload.error.size: The file must be smaller than {limit}. Split the data into smaller files.
upload.error.empty: The selected file is empty. Choose a file with data.
upload.error.none: Choose the file you want to upload.
upload.error.server: Could not upload the file. Please try again. Your selected file was kept.
upload.error.columns: Missing columns: {columns}. Download the sample file and compare the headers.
upload.error.notReady: No rows to process were found in the file. Check the headers and the separator (semicolon or comma).
upload.error.columnsServer: The file lacks required columns: revenue and date. Download the sample file and compare the headers.
upload.error.package: The JSON file does not match the collector package schema. Generate the package again with the collector script.
upload.error.decode: Could not read the file. Save it as CSV in UTF-8 encoding (separator: semicolon or comma) and upload it again.
upload.error.records: The file has too many rows. Split the data into smaller files.
upload.error.xlsx: Could not read the XLSX workbook (macros, several sheets or a damaged file). Save the data as CSV and upload it again.
upload.error.quota: The upload quota of this organization is used up. Try again after freeing space.
upload.uploading.status: Uploading the file. Processing in progress…
upload.uploaded: File uploaded. Review the detected columns.
upload.preview.title: Detected columns
upload.preview.caption: Detected column mapping
upload.preview.package: The JSON package from the collector will be processed without column mapping.
upload.error.start: Could not start the report. Please try again.
upload.progress.title: Processing the file
upload.progress.queued: The job is waiting in the queue…
upload.progress.polling: Live tracking is unavailable. Checking the status every few seconds.
upload.done.title: The report is ready
upload.failed.title: Could not prepare the report
upload.failed.body: Processing the file ended with an error (code: {code}). Check the file and try again.
upload.cancelled.title: The job was cancelled
run.heading: Report
run.title: Report from {date}
run.iframe.title: {type} from {date}
run.open: Open report in a new tab
run.download.title: Download report
run.error.title: Could not load the report
verify.title: Check it yourself
verify.lead: Choose the report file you downloaded. We calculate its SHA-256 hash in this browser and compare it with the one stored for this report.
verify.privacy: The file was not sent to the server. The check was done in this browser.
verify.match.detail: The hash of {name} is identical to the hash of the report in {format} format.
verify.mismatch.detail: The hash of {name} does not match any stored hash of this report. The file may have been changed or may come from a different report.
verify.error.insecure: This browser does not provide cryptographic functions in this context. Open the dashboard over HTTPS.
verify.error.read: Could not read the selected file. Choose it again.
verify.hashes.title: Stored SHA-256 hashes
verify.hashes.none: No hashes were stored for this report.
verify.forIt.summary: For IT staff: check the hash in a terminal
verify.forIt.body: Linux and macOS: sha256sum file.html. Windows PowerShell: Get-FileHash file.html -Algorithm SHA256.
copy.failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
evidence.title: Artifacts
evidence.lead: Check status from the latest collector run: control, requirement, status and artifact.
evidence.caption: Controls and their artifacts
evidence.details.hash: Full SHA-256 hash of the artifact
evidence.details.noCommand: No collector command was provided for this control.
evidence.empty.title: There are no artifacts yet
evidence.empty.body: Run the collector on a workstation and upload the generated JSON package. The check statuses will appear here.
evidence.error.title: Could not load the artifacts
settings.title: Settings
settings.nav.label: Settings sections
settings.retention.title: File retention
settings.retention.label: Retention period for uploaded files (days)
settings.retention.hint: After this period uploaded files are deleted from the server.
settings.retention.error: Enter the number of days as a whole number from 1 to 3650.
settings.llm.title: Language model summary
settings.llm.label: Allow a language model to summarize the report
settings.llm.desc: Off by default. When on, only aggregated numbers are sent to the model, without order numbers or product names. The report will note that the summary was generated by a model.
settings.usage.title: Usage this month
settings.webhooks.title: Webhooks
settings.webhooks.lead: We notify the given address when a report finishes. Every call is signed (X-DaaS-Signature header, HMAC).
settings.webhooks.error.url: Enter an address starting with https://, for example https://your-company.com/hooks/daas.
settings.webhooks.caption: Configured webhooks
settings.webhooks.pingFail: The test failed. Check the address and that the server is reachable.
settings.webhooks.delete.title: Delete webhook “{url}”?
settings.webhooks.delete.body: Notifications will stop being sent to this address. This cannot be undone.
settings.webhooks.delete.error: Could not delete the webhook. Please try again.
settings.webhooks.empty: No webhooks have been added yet.
settings.webhooks.secret.title: Save the signing secret
settings.webhooks.secret.body: This secret is used to verify call signatures. You can only see it now.
keys.title: API keys
keys.lead: Keys are used for automated connections, for example from n8n. You see the full key only once, right after creating it.
keys.create.title: Create a key
keys.name: Key name
keys.name.hint: For example n8n production. The name tells you what the key is for.
keys.scopes.hint: Grant only the permissions that are needed.
keys.error.name: Enter a key name so you know what it is for.
keys.error.create: Could not create the key. Please try again.
keys.list.title: Your keys
keys.list.caption: Organization API keys
keys.col.name: Name
keys.empty: You do not have any API keys yet. Create the first one using the form above.
keys.error.title: Could not load the keys
keys.revoke.title: Revoke key “{name}”?
keys.revoke.body: Applications using this key will stop working. This cannot be undone.
keys.revoke.error: Could not revoke the key. Please try again.
keys.reveal.title: Save the key now
keys.reveal.body: This is the only time you can see the full key. Copy it and store it somewhere safe, for example in a password manager. Later you will only see its prefix.
keys.reveal.label: Your new API key
